articleTypes.name: Original Investigation
articleTypes.description: Reports of original research: randomized clinical trials, other trials, meta-analyses, and observational studies (cohort, case-control, cross-sectional, case series, economic evaluations, decision models, qualitative studies). Each manuscript states an objective or hypothesis, the design and methods, the main outcome measures, the main results, and a discussion placing the results in context with the published literature and addressing study limitations.
